{{Quote|The Shaper witch has cursed us! Why has she not changed? Why have you Jedi been spared? We demand rite of punishment! Give her to us, Jedi -- or die with her!|translated=1|[[Roax]]|<ref name="Legacy 43" />}}
The '''Skirmish on Wayland''' was a confrontation between [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and members of the
[[Myneyrsh]] people following the sabotage of the [[Ossus Project]] at the hands of the [[One Sith]] and their ally, the rogue [[Shaper caste|Shaper]] [[Zenoc Quah]]. [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Kol Skywalker]] had traveled to [[Wayland/Legends|Wayland]], a world that had been ravaged by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War|war]] and had remained plagued by creatures such as [[Chrome-Vrone]]s, to oversee the implementation of the Ossus Project. The Project was a success, but six months later the Sith sabotage caused Wayland's native people, flora and fauna to mutate into [[vongspawn]].<ref name="Legacy 43" />

Blaming [[Master Shaper]] [[Nei Rin]], [[Roax]], leader of the Myneyrsh, demanded Skywalker to hand Rin over so she would face punishment. However, suspecting sabotage, Master Skywalker, alongside [[Wolf Sazen]], [[Shado Vao]] and his own son [[Cade Skywalker|Cade]], managed to escape the planet, though their shuttle was severely damaged by vong-infected vines.<ref name="Legacy 43" />

The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] ship nearly shut down and fell. However, a distress signal was answered by an [[Fel Empire|Imperial]] [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] under the command of [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Morrigan Corde|Nyna Calixte]].<ref name="Legacy 43" />
